originalDecisionRecord.reason: Director "Sarik Andreasyan" and runtime "89 minutes" match exactly, and the Description faithfully restates the authorized overview (Cold War, Patriot organization, superhero squad from Soviet republics, hiding identities, called back in hard times). However, the Why-watch field asserts the film is "Russian-language" — no spoken-language field is provided in this packet (unlike other records where spokenLanguages was explicitly authorized), so this is an unconfirmed, externally-sourced detail rather than a given fact. Separately, the Curiosity hook states the operatives have been "living in complete secrecy" for "decades" — the authorized overview says only "for years," and while the Cold War setting implies a lengthy stretch, "decades" overstates a specific, unverified duration beyond what's stated. Recommend removing the "Russian-language" claim (or generalizing to "Russian action-fantasy" tied to the authorized country field instead of language) and replacing "decades" with the authorized "years."
